spec.expr:
sum by (state) (
  label_replace(slurm_cpus_idle, "state", "idle", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_cpu_alloc, "state", "allocated", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_cpu_, "state", "mix", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_cpu_other, "state", "other", "", "")
)

(
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_running, "state", "running", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_pending, "state", "pending", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_completed, "state", "completed", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_cancelled, "state", "cancelled", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_failed, "state", "failed", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_completing, "state", "completing", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_configuring, "state", "configuring", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_preempted, "state", "preempted", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_suspended, "state", "suspended", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_node_fail, "state", "node_fail", "", "")
or
  label_replace(slurm_jobs_timeout, "state", "timeout", "", "")
)
> 0
